item.title: Hard to Fool: A Bounded LLM Research Loop for Quantitative Finance, and What Two Dozen Campaigns Found
item.content:encoded:
自主量化研究员、代理研究循环、过拟合、回测验证、严格评估标准

总结: 传统的 LLM 研究循环在量化交易中易产生伪发现。本文提出“自主量化研究员”框架：LLM 提出严格 JSON 声明，无权编写代码。评估基于不可变时序数据，需通过多重绝对标准（如成本生存、Bootstrap 下界）。系统在多种数据集上测试，多数假设失败。一个策略虽通过发现和验证（夏普比率 3），但在最终保留数据上失效（降至 0.26）。该循环的价值在于能拒绝报告虚假结果。
Agentic research loops that let a language model propose a change, run a fixed experiment and keep whatever improves the metric work well in machine learning. In trading research the same loop is a machine for producing false discoveries: a backtest that "improves the metric" is, by default, overfit, look-ahead, a multiple-comparisons artifact, cost-free, or market drift wearing a strategy. We describe Autonomous Quant Researcher, an open-source loop built on the opposite premise: the model proposes, and only trusted code decides. Proposals are strict declarative JSON over a fixed vocabulary, so there is no model-written code to sandbox. Evaluation runs on immutable chronological stores split into discovery, validation and a final holdout that can be opened exactly once, after a durable receipt is written. Acceptance is a conjunction of absolute gates (positive edge and net P&L after costs, a positive weekly-cluster bootstrap lower bound, survival at elevated costs, per-year stability and sample floors), never a single score. Duplicates are refused before they spend a trial, and every formulation, refusal, crash and result is kept in a hash-chained, append-only ledger. We report every campaign run to date, across 0DTE options priced from traded option bars, overnight SPX verticals, daily ETF rules, technical-analysis premises, Kalshi crypto binaries, earnings options, off-exchange volume and a pre-registered alternative-data campaign. Most hypotheses fail, and we report them. Two results survive their pre-registered bars. The clearest example of the loop working is a failure: a language-model survivor that passed discovery and validation with Sharpe ratios near 3 and fell to 0.26 on its single holdout use. The value of such a loop lies less in what it finds than in how hard it is to make it report something that is not there. arXiv categories: q-fin.CP, q-fin.TR

item.title: Beyond Anonymous Order Flow: Wallet Identity as a Feature for Short-Horizon Return Prediction
item.content:encoded:
Hyperliquid, Level-4记录, 钱包身份, 回报预测, 高频交易

总结: 研究利用Hyperliquid Level-4记录重建深度订单簿，分析匿名钱包身份。基于2026年7月数据，发现名义加权排名在相邻窗口间保持稳定。钱包身份特征显著提升短期回报预测精度，调整后最高分位回报达3.11基点。在高频模型中，引入相关特征使1秒预测的R2从10.88%提升至12%。
Conventional public order-book data summarize trading without identifying the accounts behind it. Hyperliquid's Level-4 record also exposes persistent pseudonymous wallet addresses. We reconstruct full-depth books from consensus-ordered messages and evaluate wallet identity as a feature for short-horizon return prediction. The July 1-27, 2026 record covers 17.1 billion messages, 14.3 million aggressive orders by 147,113 wallets, and $84.3 billion in taker notional across ten markets. In the three model markets, notional-weighted ten-second markout rankings persist across adjacent ten-day windows (Spearman rho = 0.52); covariate-adjusted validation markouts reach 3.11 basis points in the top ventile. On a 100-millisecond grid, eleven features describing previously scored top-decile wallets raise one-second out-of-sample R2 from 10.88% to 12. arXiv categories: q-fin.TR, q-fin.ST

item.title: Learning AI Agents, Market Makers, and Stress in Automated Markets
item.content:encoded:
交易代理, 自动做市商, 羊群效应, 市场压力, 做市商定价

总结: 本文研究AI交易代理在自动做市商(AMM)中的行为。羊群型与套利型市场回报相似，但压力持续时间受反馈噪声比 $\beta/s$ 影响巨大。识别反馈符号需 $\Theta((s/\beta)^2 \log(1/\delta))$ 次观测。代理协同时逐利者追随羊群导致全有或全无参与。赚取价差的做市商恢复稳定性但使流动性脆弱，引发不连续崩溃和磁滞；做市商-吃单定价是有效工具。
Automated markets increasingly route order flow from learning trading agents through automated market makers (AMMs). We model trader archetypes as AI agents defined by their reward functions and analyze the feedback they create on a constant-product AMM. Herd-dominated and arbitrage-dominated markets of equal size have identical return distributions and turnover, so no rule based on volatility, value-at-risk, stress frequency, or volume can tell them apart; yet their stress episodes differ in length by a factor unbounded in the feedback-to-noise ratio $β/s$. Serial statistics identify the feedback sign from $Θ((s/β)^2\log(1/δ))$ observations, and this rate is tight. When agents trade together, profit-seeking agents ride herds rather than lean against them, leading to all-or-nothing participation. Spread-earning market makers restore stability but make liquidity fragile, with discontinuous collapse and hysteresis; maker--taker pricing, not a uniform fee, is the effective instrument. arXiv categories: econ.EM, cs.LG, econ.TH, q-fin.TR

item.title: AIDA: An AI Outage Registry with Evidence from On-Chain MEV
item.content:encoded:
生成式AI, AIDA, MEV, 交易软件, 中断

总结: 研究发现生成式AI降低了交易软件成本，引入AIDA记录了AI中断事件。低成本代码降低了MEV准入门槛，套利者和清算者增加，但执行仍集中。AI中断会阻碍新代码发布，但已部署的机器人继续运行。尽管代码更便宜，私有的订单流、延迟和资本仍是成功的关键。
Generative AI coding tools have lowered the cost of writing trading software, but no systematic dataset records when these services fail. We introduce the AI Incident and Disruption Archive (AIDA), a multi-vendor registry of 5,868 deduplicated outage incidents across 30 providers from 2025 to 2026, with foundation-model incidents verified against primary status-page or postmortem URLs. Pairing AIDA with 5,041,034 verified maximal extractable value (MEV) transactions by 8,516 Ethereum addresses, their contract creations, and a 22-month Base Layer-2 panel of 1,099,593,191 swaps and 29,120 private executors, we establish two findings. First, entry into MEV expanded where code and public state suffice, as active arbitrage addresses quadrupled from late 2024 to late 2026 and liquidators grew by a third, while sandwich attackers, who need private order flow and builder access, declined. Execution nonetheless remained concentrated, with the top fifty addresses executing two thirds of verified trades. Second, AI outages stall new trading code while deployed bots keep trading. On Ethereum, addresses releasing a private executor fall to 0.67 on the day of an eight-hour disruption (0.68 for executor creations during OpenAI outage hours) and to 0.66 at lag two before rebounding on day three; on Base, operator top-level creations fall to 0.76 during OpenAI hours and executor-deploying operators to 0.88 at lag two. Non-trading creations, automated factory clones, and live arbitrage and sandwich execution across both chains remain unchanged. Cheaper code thus lowers the barrier to building MEV contracts, while private order flow, latency and capital still determine who wins execution. arXiv categories: q-fin.TR, cs.CE

item.title: Non-Convex Market Makers: Coherence without Convexity, Friction, and Parallel Composition
item.content:encoded:
成本函数做市商 无套利条件 非凸性 下确界卷积 去中心化预言机

总结: 成本函数做市商的凸性并非相干性的必要条件，无套利条件表现为弦条件。非凸做市商通过费用恢复相干性，组合做市商由下确界卷积解决。套利者对非相干配置定价，充当去中心化预言机。相干性取决于摩擦和寻找凭证的成本。
Cost-function market makers are always assumed convex, and convexity is not what makes them coherent. For a path-independent maker the exact no-arbitrage condition is a chord condition, that every chord slope of the cost lie in the convex hull of payoffs; convexity enters the standard axiomatics through a separate requirement, monotone information incorporation, and dropping it leaves coherent non-convex makers. Rational flow against such a maker trades the convex envelope, so non-convexity costs expressiveness rather than soundness, and a proportional fee of at least the arbitrage depth restores no-arbitrage, which by conjugation is a bid-ask spread with an exact no-trade interval for any cost whatever. Combining fee-bearing makers is an infimal convolution solved by one monotone clearing-price root-find, with sparse participation and a consolidated limit order book as the aggregate, and a deep quadratic co-quoter is Moreau smoothing, which preserves coherence at every depth. Any quoted configuration outside the coherent hull admits a portfolio priced below its worst payoff, so arbitrageurs act as decentralized separation oracles, and coherence is relative to friction and to the cost of finding certificates. arXiv categories: q-fin.MF, q-fin.TR

item.title: Reading the Count: Prediction Markets and Brazil's 2026 Presidential Election
item.content:encoded:
巴西总统选举, 投票预测, Kalshi市场, 投影误差, 投票暂停

总结: 1. 文本重建了巴西总统选举的逐区投票记录，并与Kalshi和Polymarket预测进行对比。 2. 市场标准差比逐区重建大4倍，比2018年重建大2倍。 3. 暂停期间市场概率低于事后重建数据；第一轮市场比重建快。 4. 投票恢复后买入获胜者合约预期利润为4至18美分。 5. 市场在实时准确性上存在显著误差。
We rebuild the public count of Brazil's 2026 presidential runoff minute by minute from the electoral court's section-level records and compare it with every trade on Kalshi and Polymarket. A projection published live on the night gave the eventual winner, Lula, a probability of 0.998 from 19:15, with 1.6% of sections counted. The markets reached 0.9 at 20:24, with 46% counted. Read as the projection's central estimate with a wider uncertainty, their prices imply a standard deviation of the final margin about four times the live projection's, and about twice that of a section-level projection calibrated on the 2018 runoff, the earlier night with the largest errors. Valued at these projections, takers' purchases of Lula after the count resumed had an expected profit of 4 to 18 cents per Kalshi contract after fees; valued at a state-level extrapolation of the count, it was zero. During a two-hour suspension of the count the markets gave Lula 0.25 to 0.44, below every reading we compute afterwards from the sections then public, none of which was available live. On the first-round night, when the headline count showed the eventual leader ahead from its first file, the same markets were faster than our projection. arXiv categories: q-fin.TR, econ.EM

item.title: FinLLM-KG: Knowledge Graph-Enhanced LLMs for Financial Sentiment Analysis in Algorithmic Trading
item.content:encoded:
FinLLM-KG, 金融情感分析, 知识图谱, 因果LLM, 可解释性

总结: 针对现有金融情感分析局限于孤立文章、缺乏语境及黑盒不可解释的问题。 提出FinLLM-KG框架，结合因果LLM与金融知识图谱，利用SEC 10-K文件注入公司级知识。 该方法无需更新权重，支持自然语言或三元组输入，在零计算成本下提升语境理解与投资组合表现。 同时将情感归因于句子和检索事实，增强可解释性以支持人工审查。
Recent advances in Generative AI have substantially improved financial sentiment analysis through post-trained financial large language models (LLMs). However, existing approaches remain confined to predicting the sentiment of each article in isolation and operate as black boxes, which limits contextual understanding and hinders deployment in high-stakes financial decision-making. To this end, we introduce FinLLM-KG, a model-agnostic framework that combines causal LLMs with a financial knowledge graph, in order to inject temporally grounded, company-level knowledge from SEC 10-K filings at inference time, without updating model weights. Within FinLLM-KG, context is supplied either as a natural-language company profile or as a small set of relevance-ranked factual triples. This enables sentiment predictions to account for broader firm-level information rather than the article alone, at almost zero computational cost and for any causal LLM. In addition, attributing each article-level sentiment score to individual sentences and to the retrieved knowledge-graph facts makes the evidence behind the prediction inspectable, thereby enhancing explainability and supporting human-in-the-loop review. Simulations demonstrate that FinLLM-KG consistently improves portfolio performance over the state-of-the-art baseline. arXiv categories: cs.CL, cs.LG, q-fin.ST, q-fin.TR

item.title: Fuji: The Shape, Composition, and Spread of Demand Bursts on Robinhood Chain
item.content:encoded:
区块链, 突发需求, Gas 费用, 外部触发级联, 模仿行为

总结: 1. 分析了 Robinhood Chain 上前三个月超过 5000 万次 Uniswap 交换数据。 2. 突发期间交易量与平静期相当但更频繁，峰值是中位值的 2.5 倍，呈双指数衰减。 3. 相比平静期，突发涉及更多发件人和交易。 4. 外部触发级联模型比自激模型拟合更好。 5. 突发期间存在约 24 秒的模仿行为延迟。
Demand on blockchain-based marketplaces arrives in bursts and at a high rate. On these platforms the data are completely visible, which makes it feasible to compare the bursty demand against the usual load. The congestion manifests as an increased demand for gas, the primary resource a blockchain sells. Existing studies consider how to price the gas. The demand itself, and what it is made of during bursts, has not been measured. We measure it on Robinhood Chain, a layer-2 blockchain that quickly became a venue for trading tokenized equities and memecoins. We collected the data from every block of its first three active months and more than 50 million Uniswap swaps that occurred during bursty periods. We find that a burst trades about as many pools as a quiet period, mostly different ones, and trades them harder, on top of elevated demand that accumulated for hours. With the bursts aligned on their peaks, the median peak is 2.5 times the usual load. Both the rise and the fall of the demand are described by the sum of two exponential functions with different timescales, a slow one of hours and a fast one of minutes. Against a matched quiet period, a burst has 1.05 times the pools, 1.40 times the trades, and 1.21 times the senders. We use two models to explain the arrival of bursts: externally triggered cascades and self-excitation. The former fits the data relatively better. Inside a burst, the entry of each trader into a pool is followed for about 24 seconds by more entries than the existing traders predict. Whether this is because of imitation or because of a shared signal is left open. arXiv categories: econ.EM, cs.SI, q-fin.TR

item.title: Do Round Numbers Hold Prices? Occupation Densities and Depth-Conditioned Hazards in the Limit Order Book
item.content:encoded:
价格簇, 流动性, Tick-grid, 限价订单簿, 深度调整

总结: 1. 文章利用Tick-grid框架和限价订单簿数据，区分了价格簇背后的流动性吸引与停留时间延长机制。 2. 研究发现圆整水平虽然吸引了更多流动性，但深度调整后的停留时间并未显著延长。 3. 具体分析表明，英特尔和SoFi等股票存在价格倾向于远离圆整水平的方向性偏差。
Prices cluster at round numbers, a pattern often interpreted as evidence that these levels act as price barriers. This pattern also admits a mechanical explanation: more liquidity rests there, and prices take longer to leave deeper queues. Limit order book data allow us to distinguish these mechanisms through a tick-grid framework in which local time counts departures and level-wise volatility reflects the departure hazard. Using data for five Nasdaq stocks throughout 2025, we find that round levels attract more liquidity but do not exhibit longer depth-adjusted durations. Intel and SoFi show directional effects, with departures biased away from round levels. arXiv categories: q-fin.TR, q-fin.ST

item.title: Tracking High-Frequency Trading Activity in China and Its Effects on Market Quality
item.content:encoded:
高频交易, 订单级代理指标, 活跃精确匹配订单, 延迟, 市场质量

总结: 1. 文章提出了一种基于精确订单放置的高频交易代理指标，称为活跃精确匹配订单。 2. 利用深交所数据验证，该指标响应迅速、取消快、集中度高，并能预测回报。 3. 通过利用开盘传播延迟差异发现，低延迟显著增加了此类订单。 4. 结果表明，延迟降低导致短期价格波动加大、价差更宽、逆向选择增加，但实际价差下降，定价误差微降。 5. 中国特有的市场设计使速度优势倾向于方向性流动性吃单。
We develop a new order-level proxy for high-frequency trading (HFT) activity based on precise order placement and study its effects on market quality. With quotes updating multiple times per second, millisecond-level order-book access makes high-frequency traders more likely to submit active exact-match orders, defined as limit orders priced exactly at the prevailing best opposite-side quote. Using Shenzhen Stock Exchange data, we validate the proxy: active exact-match orders respond faster to quote updates, cancel more rapidly, concentrate when depth imbalance is favorable and spreads are narrow, and predict mid-quote returns from 100 milliseconds through ten minutes. A difference-in-differences design exploiting cross-channel variation in order dissemination latency at the market open shows that lower latency increases active exact-match shares. This variation yields plausibly causal evidence that latency-induced HFT raises short-horizon price variation, wide-spread incidence, and adverse-selection exposure, while realized spreads decline and pricing error falls modestly. Unlike developed markets, China's T+1 constraint, absence of maker-taker rebates, and limits on rapid quote revision tilt speed advantages toward directional liquidity taking, highlighting how market design shapes the channel through which speed affects market quality. arXiv categories: q-fin.TR

item.title: Optimal Size in Market Making under State-Dependent Hawkes Process
item.content:encoded:
市场做市, 执行量, Hawkes模型, Prony级数, 限价订单簿

总结: 本文提出一种包含平均订单规模、指数需求函数及状态依赖Prony级数乘数的执行量参数模型，利用Hawkes模型构建市场订单计数。基于限价订单簿数据校准模型，利用紧致状态域上的近似结果作为数学基础。实证显示，该模型在满足库存约束下比基线具有更高效用，有效区分了交易收入与库存控制的贡献。此外，闭式体积规范将报价水平作为输入，适用于不同报价规则。
We study market making with a parametric model of executed volume that accounts for quote placement and state-dependent order flow. Executed volume is expressed as the product of an average order size, an exponential demand function, and a Prony-series multiplier depending on quote depth, market-order count constructed from a state-dependent Hawkes model. An approximation result for finite Prony sums on a compact state domain provides a mathematical basis for the representation. An empirical study of limit-order-book data examines the calibrated demand and intensity models, sensitivity to inventory restrictions, and the resulting placement policies. In retrospective evaluations conditional on realised order-flow paths, the selected calibration achieves higher terminal utility than a baseline while respecting the prescribed inventory bound. The comparisons also distinguish the contribution of trading revenues from that of inventory control. The resulting closed-form volume specification takes placement levels as inputs and can therefore be used with alternative quoting rules. arXiv categories: q-fin.TR, q-fin.CP, q-fin.MF

item.title: Early-Buyer Groups and Fast-Wallet Teams on a Bonding-Curve Launchpad: A Prospective Measurement Study of pump.fun on Solana
item.content:encoded:
pump.fun, 钱包组, 协调交易, 流动性曲线, 评估误差

总结: 1. 研究分析了pump.fun上的钱包组，发现其分为序列创作者和早期买家圈。 2. 验证显示早期买家获利，晚期亏损，早期信号对跟风者无利可图。 3. 快速钱包群组虽能提高达到20 SOL的概率，但信号往往滞后。 4. 文章指出数据评估存在误差，可能导致看似盈利的假象。
We study coordinated groups of wallets on a bonding-curve launchpad (pump.fun on Solana), using a complete record of 200\,443 token launches, 15\,854\,121 curve trades and 51\,025\,958 SOL transfers over 88.3 hours. A prospective, multi-channel discovery procedure (co-buying, shared funding, joint signing, transfers, consolidation) yields 23\,710 wallet groups. Without ground-truth labels we validate them by out-of-sample link prediction, independent non-trading links and a comparison with naive co-buy clustering at equal numbers of flagged tokens: raw clustering collapses into one giant component, yet it ranks tokens at least as well as the groups, so the value of the structure is descriptive. Group activity is highly concentrated and splits into serial creators and long-lived rings of early buyers. Known members buy earlier than other buyers of the same token and extract more cash than an activity-matched placebo set, while late buyers' net cash flow is negative; tokens with members show a pump-like price path, but the contrast vanishes when controls are restricted to comparable tokens, so we report it as an association. A follower entering at the earliest group signal loses money out of sample in all 32 configurations and does no better than random entry. A few pools of tens to over a hundred fast wallets are associated with a two- to four-fold higher chance of reaching 20 SOL, also within creators, with a smaller excess at 60 SOL and none for graduation; on a final hold-out the team rules keep a precision of about one half to three quarters, yet many signals arrive when the curve already holds 20 SOL, one team supplies most of them, and they add no information beyond early curve state. We also document evaluation errors that turn the same data into apparent profit. arXiv categories: physics.soc-ph, cs.SI, q-fin.TR

item.title: Calibration of Passive Market Impact with a Queue-Sensitive Propagator Model
item.content:encoded:
被动市场影响, 限价单, 价格分解, 订单流不平衡, Hawkes模型

总结: 本文构建了校准被动市场影响的框架，区别于市价单影响。基于Hawkes模型与队列反应动态，研究将价格分解为通用传播子项和状态相关校正项。该分解连接了微观结构与标准传播子模型。通过高频数据校准，发现被动影响项显著解释了价格变化，提升了模型拟合度及影响曲线预测的准确性。
We develop a framework for calibrating passive market impact, defined as the price response to liquidity-providing limit orders, in contrast to the impact of liquidity-consuming market orders. We build on the model of Ouazzani Chahdi, Rosenbaum, and Szymanski (arxiv:2412.07461), which combines Hawkes-driven market-order flow with queue-reactive limit-order and cancellation dynamics. Within this model, we show that the price decomposes into a universal propagator term driven by signed order-flow imbalance and a state-dependent correction that captures the dependence of price sensitivity on volume at the best quotes. This decomposition links limit-order-book microstructure to standard propagator models and yields a regression on two observable signals: the propagator signal and the queue-weighted order-flow imbalance. We calibrate the model on high-frequency order-book data and find that the passive-impact term explains substantial variation in prices beyond the classical propagator, improving both model fit and the accuracy of predicted impact curves. arXiv categories: q-fin.TR, math.PR, q-fin.MF, q-fin.ST

item.title: Optimal Order Placement under a State-Dependent Hawkes Process Limit Order Book model
item.content:encoded:
Hawkes过程, 市场做市商, 动态规划, 库存惩罚, 最优报价

总结: 本文利用状态依赖的Hawkes过程和基于块的线性需求规格建模订单流。在二次终端库存惩罚下，通过连续时间离散状态动态规划，推导出依赖库存的最优报价及二次值函数递归公式。数值实验基于LOBSTER数据，表明该策略在1和3个tick时优于固定价差基准，但低于2个tick基准，验证了框架的数值实现及终端财富与库存惩罚目标的区别。
We study optimal quote placement for a market maker facing order flow modeled by a state-dependent Hawkes process. A block-based linear demand specification links market-order counts to execution volumes, providing the demand moments required by a continuous time discrete state dynamic programming formulation. Under a quadratic terminal inventory penalty, we characterize inventory-dependent quotes and derive backward recursions for the coefficients of a quadratic value function. Numerical experiments using LOBSTER data examine quote distributions, inventory exposure, and terminal wealth. The implemented strategy yields higher aggregate terminal wealth than fixed-spread benchmarks at one and three ticks, but lower wealth than the two-tick benchmark. These results illustrate the framework's numerical implementation and distinguish terminal-wealth comparisons from evaluation under the inventory-penalized objective. arXiv categories: q-fin.TR, q-fin.CP, q-fin.MF

item.title: Depositing More Should Not Earn Less: Supplier Income Monotonicity and Rate Curve Design in Pooled Lending Markets
item.content:encoded:
利用依赖型利率模型、供应商收入、弹性上限、Drift市场、设计约束

总结：文章分析了利用依赖型利率模型中，供应商收入可能随流动性增加而减少的条件（α(1+η)≤1）。在Drift市场实证中，发现部分时段供应商份额超过保护范围。协议将此转化为设计约束，通过设定各利用水平的保护份额上限来限制弹性。保护恒定份额导致幂律边界，保护新存款人导致双曲线边界。在多折点USDT市场中，合规修复通过影响收入对存款的响应来改变供应商收入。
In utilization dependent interest rate models, adding liquidity can reduce a supplier's total interest income even as the supplier's balance increases. A supplier holding a fraction $α$ of final pool supply keeps income nondecreasing with a marginal deposit exactly when $α(1+η)\leq1$, where $η$ is the elasticity of the borrow rate with respect to utilization. When the condition fails, the supplier can instead raise its income by withdrawing, which pushes utilization further up. On two public Drift markets, a lender held more of the pool than the curve protected in at least one hour in nine on SOL and one in thirteen on USDC. A protocol turns this into a design constraint by choosing, at each utilization, the largest supplier share it intends to protect. That choice caps the elasticity, and integrating the cap describes every admissible curve. Protecting the same share at every utilization gives a power law boundary, and protecting every fresh depositor gives a hyperbolic one. On a multiple kink USDT market, compliant repairs can lower or raise supplier income, because the constraint governs how income responds to a deposit and not the price level. arXiv categories: q-fin.TR

item.title: Event definition and the branching ratio: Hawkes estimates of price-change clustering in the consolidated quote feed
item.content:encoded:
Hawkes模型, 价格变动, 大tick股票, 内核成分, 临界值

总结: Hawkes模型发现亚毫秒内核和临界分支比。在大tick股票中，该内核源于报价系统的构建（锁单/枯竭），被误读为激发。将事件定义为持续1毫秒的中间价水平可去除该成分。原始拟合显示三倍内核质量在1秒内，仿真重现。因分支比与基线权衡，报告固定窗口内核质量。
Hawkes models of price changes in the consolidated US quote feed find a sub-millisecond kernel component and a branching ratio near criticality. We show that in large-tick stocks the first is the feed's construction: half of NBBO changes are locks or depleted quotes, resolved within a millisecond, which the model reads as excitation. Defining the event as a mid-price level persisting for one millisecond removes the component. Raw fits put three times the clean kernel mass within one second, which a simulation reproduces. Since the total branching ratio trades off against the baseline, we report kernel mass on a fixed window. arXiv categories: q-fin.ST, q-fin.CP, q-fin.TR

item.title: Decorrelating the Advice Layer: A Calibrated Fragility Metric and Tested Mitigations for Synchronized Liquidation in Agentic Wealth Management
item.content:encoded:
财富管理, AI代理, 尾部风险, 模型集中度, 同步自动化

总结: 基于真实数据构建AI代理模型，发现有效决策者仅约2.0，导致个股拥挤但未引发市场清算。指数尾部损失随代理采用率平方根增长，比周期性机器人高1.47-1.90倍，主要由同步自动化而非模型集中度驱动。解耦自动化可减少63%尾部损失且成本低。脆弱性指数预测效果佳，历史回测显示2020年崩盘因代理层加深了858个基点。
Conversational AI agents are turning wealth management into a continuous loop of market analysis, allocation, risk checks and execution, run for millions of clients on a handful of foundation models. We build a multi-asset agent-based model of this layer, calibrated to measured model concentration, cross-model correlation, retail turnover and 33 years of real equity returns, and ask when the layer amplifies market declines and what prevents it. The effective number of independent decision-makers is bounded however many clients the layer serves: about 2.0 at today's consumer concentration. This monoculture of views drives crowding in individual securities and sets the blast radius of a compromised model provider, but it does not drive market-wide liquidation. Index tail losses rise with the square root of agentic adoption, are 1.47-1.90 times larger under an agentic than under a periodic robo-advice architecture, and do not rise with model concentration; synchronized automation (risk overlays, drawdown cuts and attention-driven execution) drives them. A fragility index computed from aggregate flow, public returns and an impact estimate forecasts tail liquidation out of sample (hold-out R^2 of 0.56) far better than concentration or correlation measures. Decorrelating the automation, not the models, works: dispersing overlay parameters, staging execution and a participation breaker together cut tail liquidation by 63% at no measurable cost to client welfare, whereas provider diversification has no effect. Because the statistics required are sums, they can be computed across platforms under secure aggregation with differential privacy at negligible cost for realistic client populations. In historical replays, an agentic layer holding 10% of the market would have deepened the 2020 crash by about 858 basis points. arXiv categories: q-fin.RM, q-fin.PM, q-fin.TR

item.title: Understanding the Inner Workings of a State-Space Foundation Model for Limit Order Books
item.content:encoded:
Mamba-3, 限价订单簿, 订单流不平衡, 市场微观结构, 内部表示

总结: 1. 研究利用8.2M参数的Mamba-3状态空间模型，在8只美股的限价订单簿消息流上训练。 2. 模型学到了市场动态，能高精度解码订单流不平衡（$R^2 \approx 0.59$）。 3. 表示适用于未见过的股票，证明是通用特征而非特定代码。 4. 模型表示具有因果可解释性，改变状态会按预期影响预测。
arXiv:2610.28753v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autoregressive foundation models offer state-of-the-art capabilities to simulate the market by generating the message flow of limit order books (LOBs). Yet, without understanding their inner workings, research directions are hard to narrow and practical use in real-world trading environments remains uncertain. This study therefore asks what these models actually learn about market microstructure. We find that, similarly to games where sequence models build an internal representation of the board, an 8.2M-parameter Mamba-3 state-space model trained autoregressively on the tokenized message stream of eight large-cap US equities learns an internal representation of the market and its dynamics. In particular, order-flow imbalance, a central driver of short-horizon price moves, is decodable at $R^2 \approx 0.59$, far above controls and baselines. This representation extends to unseen stocks, suggesting that these models learn general representations rather than ticker-specific patterns. The model also generalizes across metrics beyond order-flow imbalance: results hold across traded volume and volatility. Additionally, the representation is causally steerable: pushing the state along a feature's axis shifts the model's next-message beliefs as that feature implies, monotonically in dose, consistent with the emergence of a world model.

item.title: Combinatorial Arbitrage in Prediction Markets
item.content:encoded:
预测市场 套利 逻辑关系 整数规划 无风险收益

总结: * 提出识别逻辑相关合约套利的框架，证明价格在允许的支付向量凸包之外存在套利。 * 利用元数据和语义分析恢复190万个逻辑关系，构建覆盖25万个合约的约束系统。 * 通过整数编程寻找最优套利组合，并模拟在Polymarket上的执行。 * 研究发现理想套利者每周可赚取3.5%的无风险收益，且套利机会持续更久。
arXiv:2610.23517v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop a framework to identify and quantify arbitrage across logically related prediction-market contracts. We prove that prices outside the convex hull of admissible payoff vectors admit arbitrage and identify optimal arbitrage portfolios through integer programming. Using venue metadata and semantic analysis of resolution criteria, we recover 1.9 million logical relations and compile them into constraint systems covering more than 255,000 contracts. We replay full-depth Polymarket order books to simulate an arbitrageur executing these portfolios against resting orders. Among settled portfolios, an ideal arbitrageur that takes the full displayed depth of every opportunity and reuses its capital at resolution earns a risk-free return of 3.5% a week after spreads and fees. We find that arbitrage opportunities persist longer and attract less observed participation where relation discovery and execution are more costly.

item.title: Strategic Index Reconstitution: Differential Games, Closed-Loop Equilibria and Mean-Field Dynamics
item.content:encoded:
多资产交易博弈, 指数重构, 机会主义交易, 纳什均衡, 均值场极限

总结: 本文研究指数重构期间的多资产交易博弈。机会主义交易者基于异质信念建立库存，在公告后调整并在实施日与指数基金对冲。在无价格操纵条件下，构建了子博弈完美纳什均衡，通过非标准矩阵 Riccati 方程计算仿射反馈策略。均值场极限下构建均衡并证明定量收敛。数值表明：竞争加剧减少实施日波动，机会主义降低实施不足（除非价格弹性低），信念分散度增加总交易量。
arXiv:2609.15901v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study a continuous-time, multiasset trading game around index reconstitution, in which opportunistic traders have heterogeneous beliefs about the future index constitution and interact through transient cross-asset price impact and instantaneous execution costs. Opportunistic traders build inventory based on their individual beliefs about the future index constitution before a public announcement, adjust their positions to the revealed composition, and unwind them against the indexer's prescribed rebalancing trades at the implementation date when the new index composition takes effect. Under a no-price-manipulation condition, we construct a subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium. Its affine feedback policies are computed from a non-standard matrix Riccati equation and linear ODEs whose number and dimensions are independent of population size. Under mean-field scaling, we construct a mean-field equilibrium and obtain quantitative convergence and approximate-Nash bounds. Numerical illustrations show that greater competition among opportunists dampens price swings around implementation and that opportunistic trading lowers the indexer's implementation shortfall unless price resilience is very low. Holding the average belief fixed, greater belief dispersion can increase gross trading volume without changing net aggregate opportunist holdings or price impact.
